Just wanted to quick announce the release of the zChessClock app!

Check out the app [on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zchess-clock/id6754953115), or [on GitHub](https://github.com/zobiejrz/zChessClock).

The main site for it is [zchessclock.app](https://www.zchessclock.app), which is where I'll keep updated with any release announcements and news.

And finally, feel free to check out [the blog post I made](/posts/zchess-clock-making/) to learn more about my approach to representing time controls!
